tasks.name: Fleet Target Sweep (3 Drones) 1
tasks.content: Three-drone target sweep: Drone 16, Drone 25, and Drone 6 take off together to 17 meters altitude. Drone 16 flies to target Circle Target 7, Drone 25 flies to target Circle Target 5, and Drone 6 flies to target Circle Target 3. After reaching the targets, all three drones move west for 64m, then south for 77m, then north for 70m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 64m, south 77m, north 70m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

All drones must complete the full directional distance (west 64m, south 77m, north 70m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.
